summary.text: Charlotte Magoon is the Green Party nominee for Michigan's 2nd District. A registered nurse, she describes herself as a longtime Kent County resident who attended college as a single mother.

paragraphs.text: In her Ballotpedia survey, Magoon says she has lived in Kent County most of her life and attended college as a single mother.
She earned a nursing degree (BSN) from Grand Valley State University in 2009.

She says she has worked as a nurse for 17 years in inpatient acute care, rehabilitation, long-term care and now community hospice, and that before nursing she worked in food service and as a factory worker and ran a home daycare.
